ns2:course.label: ABE Principles: Soil & Water
ns2:course.description: Engineering principles and methods of design and management of natural resources and environmental systems; watershed and hydrologic cycle; infiltration and surveying; runoff and erosion; water quality; non-point source pollution. Prerequisite: One of MATH 220, MATH 221, MATH 234.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: One of MATH 220, MATH 221, MATH 234.
